mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals an active monetary tightening cycle, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which triggers a sell-off in equities due to higher risk of rate hikes, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (HOUST) above 1,300,000 units signals strong housing market demand, which correlates with rising consumer confidence and future consumption, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 102.0, following a prior rise above 105.0, signals a contraction in manufacturing output, indicating weakening economic momentum and reduced corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5d returns in > 60% of cases when INDPRO drops below 102.0 after a prior rise above 105.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand strength, which signals sustained economic growth and higher corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL above 2.5% and FEDFUNDS above 2.0% signals a high-inflation, high-rate regime, where monetary policy is restrictive and inflation expectations are entrenched, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60d returns in > 60% of cases when both CPIAUCSL > 2.5 and FEDFUNDS > 2.0, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% combined with a rise in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 150,000, signals a labor market overheating, increasing the likelihood of Fed rate hikes and reducing equity risk appetite, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS > 150000, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 485,000 million dollars, combined with a rise in GDP (GDPC1) above 17,400 billion dollars, indicates strong aggregate demand growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60d returns in > 60% of cases when both RSAFS > 485000 and GDPC1 > 17400, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
